name: Deone Drapala
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker / Counsellor
description: Deone (she/her) is a queer Accredited Mental Health Social Worker... currently working as an LGBTIQA+ specialist and Transgender & Non Binary Ally. Interest areas include Gender Dysphoria and Questioning Sexuality.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, transgender, non-binary, gender dysphoria, sexuality

name: Luke Samios
title: Counsellor
description: Warm, inclusive and person-centred counselling via telehealth for adults and young people, with a particular focus on supporting LGBTQIA+ clients... drawing on trauma-informed approaches; supports clients experiencing trauma, grief, substance use.

name: Eva Koukoura
title: Counsellor (ACA)
description: I offer warm, queer-affirming counselling for LGBTQIA+ adults navigating anxiety, relationships, identity... drawing on narrative and somatic therapies. Online counselling across Australia.

name: Jamie Goodison
title: Counsellor
description: Affirming environment with young people, adults, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and those who are neurodiverse. Person-centered therapy for presentations including relationships, sexuality, gender identity, depression, anxiety.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, sexuality, gender identity, neurodiverse, young people

name: Kunal Shah
title: Counsellor / Psychotherapist (ACA)
description: An ACA-accredited counsellor providing trauma-informed, research-based, and LGBTQIA+ affirming support... areas of focus include IBS, childhood trauma, anxiety, addiction. Draws on CBT, EFIT/EFT, ACT, Narrative, Somatic Therapy and Inner Child Healing.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, childhood trauma, migrants, South Asian, somatic, IBS

name: AJ D'Costa
title: Counsellor (PACFA)
description: AJ D'Costa (she/her) is a Counsellor offering culturally attuned, queer-affirming & neurodivergent-affirming care in Naarm/Melbourne & across Australia. Integrates Compassion Focused Therapy, Outdoor Health & Buddhism-informed analysis.

name: Adam Forman
title: Counsellor (ACA)
description: Counselling for individuals, couples, and relationship groups navigating ethical non-monogamy (ENM). Led by a queer counsellor with lived experience in ENM. All genders, sexualities, neurotypes, and relationship configurations are welcome.

name: Maria Kairouz
title: Psychotherapist / Counsellor
description: Our team includes LGBTQ+ identifying professionals... proud to support LGBTQ+ individuals and couples, including those in non-traditional and polyamorous relationships. Specialises in supporting individuals impacted by family and domestic violence and sexual violence; trauma-informed.
specialties: LGBTQ+, polyamory, trauma, sexual violence, family violence, couples
